A1.justification: Both PDFs contain complete, readable versions of the same LTS-FS research, including Sections 1–17, all figures, tables, equations and supplementary material. Their contents can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original benchmark evaluations, ablations, transfer experiments, timing measurements and qualitative examples in the main text and appendix.

after.justification: v2 retains these original experimental results, including Tables 1–13 and the qualitative evaluations.

M1.justification: Algorithm 1 corrects its return value from h_l to the already-computed steered feature. This is a limited pseudocode correction consistent with its existing stated output; the attribution equations, sparsification and steering mechanism otherwise remain unchanged.

E1.justification: Calibration sources and evaluation coverage are retained, including CHAIR, POPE, MME, LLaVA-Bench, appendix CLAIR evaluations and cross-dataset transfer tests. Figure 1's MMMU comparison is also retained.

E2.justification: Corresponding comparisons retain the same methods: Regular, VCD, AGLA, Nullu, VTI and the two LTS-FS integrations. The smaller MME, GPT-4V and timing comparisons also retain their comparator sets.

E3.justification: Both versions specify 100 token-level and 100 sentence-level calibration samples, disjoint construction/evaluation data, the same model configurations and evaluation metrics. Appendix decoding settings, transfer protocols and the GPT-4V evaluation prompt are unchanged.

E4.justification: The granularity, threshold, soft-gating and indicator ablations remain unchanged in Tables 4, 5 and 11. The transfer analysis in Table 12 and qualitative cases in Figures 5 and 7 are also retained without new analyses.

E5.justification: Section 4.1 in both versions reports averaging metrics across three independent runs with distinct random seeds. Neither adds seed identifiers, confidence intervals, error bars or significance testing.

E6.justification: The numerical results in Tables 1–13 and the plotted and qualitative outcomes are unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains LLaVA-v1.5-7B LTS-FS(VTI) scores of 35.8 for C_S and 11.9 for C_I. Corrected metric labels do not represent new measurements.

T1.justification: Equations 1–7 retain the same forward-pass, attribution and weighting definitions. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, propositions or proofs are added or substantively revised.

C1.justification: Both retain the same three contributions: the two-granularity dataset, intervention-based layer attribution and selective feature steering. The central claim of mitigating hallucinations while preserving general capability remains; revised contribution wording does not establish a different scientific scope.

C2.justification: The explanations concerning feature-distribution preservation, complementary hallucination granularities, transfer and preparation-versus-inference costs retain their meaning. Section 17 preserves the same limitations concerning 70B-scale models and additional multimodal domains.

D1.justification: The revised introduction explicitly describes expert categorization after automatic hallucination detection and averaging layer scores across both sample types. These clarify the existing construction and aggregation process rather than establish new experiments. Hardware, hyperparameters and code access remain unchanged; the existing code link moves to the abstract.

R1.justification: The bibliography consolidates duplicate entries for the POPE paper and Visual Instruction Tuning and updates bibliographic metadata. No distinct cited work is added or removed, and the positioning relative to feature steering, localization and sparse adjustment remains unchanged.

P1.justification: The introduction reorganizes its method summary and expands the dataset and aggregation explanation. Language is polished throughout the main text and appendix, with affiliation/contact and cross-reference edits. The overall section organization remains intact.

P2.justification: Figure 3 is redrawn with the same workflow, Table 6 changes columns, and other content reflows. Table 1's caption and Tables 4–5 correct duplicated C_S labels to C_I. Figure 1's caption loses its panel (b) explanation, leaving an incomplete sentence.

improvement.justification: v2 modestly improves clarity through the expanded calibration/aggregation description, corrected Algorithm 1 return value, repaired metric labels and language editing. These gains outweigh the small regression in Figure 1's incomplete caption. The experimental evidence and substantive conclusions remain unchanged, so the improvement is limited.
